bid_awarded.title: Your bid was awarded
bid_awarded.body: You won {{reference}}. Order {{orderReference}} is now open — payment is held in Safe Deal escrow until you confirm delivery.

dispatched.title: Order dispatched
dispatched.body: {{cargo}} is on its way. Share your delivery OTP with the driver on arrival.

load_assigned.title: New load assigned
load_assigned.body: Pick up {{cargo}} from {{fromCity}} — ask the seller for the pickup OTP.

delivered_seller.title: Delivered
delivered_seller.body: Order {{reference}} was delivered. You can now raise an invoice.

payout_requested.title: Payout requested
payout_requested.body: Your withdrawal request for {{amount}} was received and is under review.

payout_approved.title: Payout sent
payout_approved.body: Your withdrawal of {{amount}} has been approved and paid out.

payment_failed.title: Payment failed
payment_failed.body: We could not charge your card for {{plan}}. We will retry — update your payment method to avoid losing your plan.

past_due.title: Subscription past due
past_due.body: {{plan}} could not be renewed. Attempt {{attempt}} of {{max}}.

downgraded.title: Moved to the free plan
downgraded.body: {{plan}} was not renewed, so your account is now on the free plan. Your data is untouched.

canceled.title: Subscription cancelled
canceled.body: {{plan}} will stay active until {{until}}, then move to the free plan.

quota_warning.title: Approaching your plan limit
quota_warning.body: You have used {{used}} of your {{limit}} {{quota}}. Upgrade for more.

renewal_upcoming.title: {{plan}} renews on {{until}}
renewal_upcoming.body: We will charge {{amount}} to your saved payment method on {{until}}. Nothing to do — you can change or cancel the plan any time before that date.

renewal_action_needed.title: Add a payment method to keep {{plan}}
renewal_action_needed.body: Your {{plan}} plan runs out on {{until}} and there is no saved payment method to renew it with. Add one and the plan continues without a break.

expiring_soon.title: {{plan}} ends on {{until}}
expiring_soon.body: Your cancelled {{plan}} plan stays active until {{until}}. After that the account moves to the free plan, which caps {{quota}} at {{limit}}. Resume any time before then to keep everything as it is.

addon_expiring.title: {{addon}} ends on {{until}}
addon_expiring.body: Your {{addon}} purchase finishes on {{until}}. Renew it to keep the placement running without a gap.

expiring_soon_plain.title: {{plan}} ends on {{until}}
expiring_soon_plain.body: Your cancelled {{plan}} plan stays active until {{until}}, then the account moves to the free plan. Resume any time before then to keep everything as it is.

outbid.title: You've been outbid
outbid.body: Someone placed a higher bid on “{{product}}”. The current top bid is {{amount}}.

won.title: You won the auction
won.body: Your {{amount}} bid won “{{product}}”. Complete your order to secure it — payment is held in Safe Deal escrow until you confirm delivery.

sold.title: Your auction sold
sold.body: “{{product}}” closed at {{amount}} — {{buyer}} is the winning buyer. The funds are held in Safe Deal escrow and released to you once delivery is confirmed.

awarded.title: You won a buyer bid
awarded.body: Your bid on {{reference}} was awarded. Order {{orderReference}} is open — the buyer’s payment is held in Safe Deal escrow until delivery is confirmed.

cancelled.title: Hire cancelled
cancelled.body: {{actor}} cancelled the hire {{reference}}. Any held funds were refunded.

assigned.title: You've been assigned a job
assigned.body: You were assigned to loading job {{reference}}.

quote_new.title: New transport quote
quote_new.body: A transporter quoted {{amount}} on your request.

assigned.title: Trip assigned
assigned.body: Your quote was accepted — trip {{reference}} from {{fromCity}} to {{toCity}} is assigned to you.

verified.title: Identity verified
verified.body: Your account is now verified — full trading features are unlocked.

rejected.title: Verification needs attention
rejected.body: Your verification was not approved. Please review and resubmit.

approved.title: Market approved

approved.title: Listing approved

approved.title: You're now a {{role}}

declined.title: Role request declined

assigned_user.title: An agent is now handling your request

resolved.title: Your ticket was resolved — rate your support

upgrade_benefits.body: Room to grow: your cap on {{quota}} goes from {{limit}} to {{paidLimit}}, and you get {{perk}}. It is {{price}} and you can cancel any time — your data and everything you have already published stay exactly as they are either way.

upgrade_benefits_feature.title: What {{paidPlan}} would add to your account
upgrade_benefits_feature.body: {{paidPlan}} gives you {{perk}}, so the people looking for what you do can find you and reach you directly. It is {{price}} and you can cancel any time — everything you have already published stays exactly as it is either way.

upgrade_final.title: Last note about upgrading
upgrade_final.body: This is the last email we will send you about plans. Your free {{plan}} account carries on unchanged. If its cap of {{limit}} on {{quota}} ever gets in the way, {{paidPlan}} is {{price}} and takes a minute to start.

upgrade_final_feature.title: Last note about upgrading
upgrade_final_feature.body: This is the last email we will send you about plans. Your free {{plan}} account carries on unchanged. If you ever want {{perk}}, {{paidPlan}} is {{price}} and takes a minute to start.

upgrade_intro.title: Your free plan caps {{quota}} at {{limit}}
upgrade_intro.body: You are on {{plan}}, which caps {{quota}} at {{limit}}. {{paidPlan}} raises that to {{paidLimit}} and adds {{perk}} — {{price}}, cancel any time.

upgrade_intro_feature.title: Your free plan does not include {{perk}}
upgrade_intro_feature.body: You are on {{plan}}, and {{perk}} is not part of it. {{paidPlan}} adds it for {{price}} — cancel any time.
